## About Eastlake
- Eastlake is a master-planned community in eastern Chula Vista, San Diego County, California, developed in phases beginning in the 1980s.
- Residential neighborhoods: Eastlake Hills, Eastlake Shores, Eastlake Greens, Eastlake Trails, Eastlake Trails North, The Woods and Eastlake Vistas.
- Three master homeowners associations: Eastlake I (Shores, Hills), Eastlake II (Greens), Eastlake III (Trails, Trails North, Vistas, Woods).
- Schools are in the Chula Vista Elementary School District and the Sweetwater Union High School District. EastLake Elementary opened in 1989, Eastlake High School in 1992 and EastLake Middle School in 2003.
- Mello-Roos (CFD) special taxes in Eastlake: Sweetwater Union High School District CFD No. 1 (Eastlake), for school facilities, which can end once bonds are repaid; City of Chula Vista CFD 07M (Eastlake III Woods & Vistas), a maintenance CFD.
- Not Mello-Roos: City of Chula Vista Open Space District 101 (Eastlake Maintenance District #1, formed 1986), an assessment district for Eastlake Hills, Shores, Village Center, Business Center and northern Greens. It appears on tax bills as "EASTLK MAINT #1 ZN [zone]", sometimes listed with CFD charges, and is designed to be permanent. Always verify for a specific parcel.
